sections.what_happened: ATTRIBUTED REPORT, NOW CORROBORATED: Mohammed Ali al-Ansar Allah wrote on Telegram that Egypt and its parliament, by authorising defensive military support for Saudi Arabia, 'are thereby declaring war on the Republic of Yemen, while doing Israel an immense favour' / 'an enormous favour'. He added Egypt is being lured into war 'as they were lured in the sixties' and that the move 'renders a great service to Israel... waiting for the opportunity to pounce on Sinai' (Türkiye Today, AFP photo). The statement was part of a longer post reacting to the Monday 2026-10-26 Tehran visit by Saudi Defence Minister Khalid bin Salman, Pakistan army chief Gen Asim Munir and Türkiye intelligence chief Ibrahim Kalin, who met SNSC head Mohsen Rezaei and President Masoud Pezeshkian to de-escalate. Al-Ansar Allah also called the Mecca pact 'a clear and blatant act of aggression against the Islamic Republic of Iran' and said the group is 'not afraid of any alliance'. GAP CLOSED: the Egyptian approval is no longer single-sourced -- Reuters+AP record at 1300-02 (two-thirds majority, closed session, no tally published, defensive only per Sisi, no attack on Yemen; AP regional official: air-defence systems + aircraft, no ground troops in Yemen). What is STILL unspecified: what Egyptian support, if any, has actually deployed, and whether Riyadh has made a formal request.
sections.what_verified: AFP (T1) reporting the Telegram statement via CNA/FMT/Malay Mail carries + Ynetnews (T3) + Times of Israel (T3) independently carrying the same quote = 3 distinct publisher families. Yeni Safak, Vanguard, ABP Live and Türkiye Today are NOT in the source registry and count for nothing. The 'declaration of war' framing is rhetoric about a defensive authorisation, not evidence of an Egyptian attack or a Ansar Allah attack on Egypt.
sections.what_disputed: Sisi's stated position, repeated in the same reports: support is to 'defend Saudi territory, and does not include an attack on Yemen'. Egypt has not joined the Mecca mutual-defence pact and, per FMT/CNA, Pakistan and Türkiye have announced no strikes on the Ansar Allah since the group ramped up attacks on Saudi Arabia in early October. No Egyptian deployment, Saudi formal request, or Ansar Allah attack on Egypt is reported in-window.
sections.why_matters: EGYPT ENTERS THE WAR MAP: Cairo authorised troops for Saudi defence, and the Ansar Allah just called it a declaration of war -- the Arab world's biggest army is now one Saudi request from the fight. Lead with al-Ansar Allah's quote, then the two-thirds vote and Sisi's defensive-only line.
